item_name: Rothco X Bear Archery Fred Bear Camo Special Ops Soft Shell Jacket
item_short_desc: From bowhunters and fishermen to tactical enthusiasts, the Fred Bear Camo Special Ops Soft Shell Jacket is designed to keep you warm and dry while out in the wilderness. As part of Rothco’s rugged Soft Shell outerwear series, the tactical bowhunting coat shields you from cold and wet weather. The Soft Shell Waterproof 3-layer fabric system deflects wind, retains heat, and releases moisture. description: From bowhunters and fishermen to tactical enthusiasts, the Fred Bear Camo Special Ops Soft Shell Jacket is designed to keep you warm and dry while out in the wilderness. As part of Rothco’s rugged Soft Shell outerwear series, the tactical bowhunting coat shields you from cold and wet weather. The Soft Shell Waterproof 3-layer fabric system deflects wind, retains heat, and releases moisture. The high-performance fabric will help protect and keep you comfortable while braving the elements, perfect for hunters, bowfishers, and outdoor adventurers. Two Iconic Brands Unite: In collaboration with Bear Archery, the revered Fred Bear camouflage pattern comes to life through Rothco’s legendary outdoor apparel and gear, including our Special Ops Soft Shell Jacket. Each item in the Fred Bear Camouflage collection has been crafted using the iconic Fred Bear camo pattern. Comfortable Fleece Lining: The weatherproof bowhunting jacket features a soft fleece lining that keeps you warm, ideal for hunting trips and outdoor adventures. The fleece-lined collar features a removable stowaway hood and provides additional protection from the elements. High-Capacity Storage: The cold weather hunting jacket comes equipped with 8 tactical zipper pockets: 2 shoulder pockets, 2 chest pockets, 2 internal pockets, 1 rear game bag back pocket, and 1 arm pocket for providing additional storage space for hunting essentials and outdoor supplies. Utility at the Forefront: The soft shell hunter jacket features underarm ventilation zippers that ensure optimal comfort by allowing air circulation. The drawstring waist and adjustable elastic wrist cuffs provide a perfect fit, while the two-way zipper offers quick and easy access. In addition, the 2 shoulder loop fields allow you to easily wear patches.
